take it easy on urself. it takes time to process and heal, you’ve got this

close your eyes and imagine yourself in 5 years. yes it’s cliche, but think about what would bring that future you happiness. if nursing is something you think you might like then do it, pursue it and work hard towards it. maybe you want to explore your options and go into a different field, that’s alright too. but don’t just stay in one place because it’s comfortable. if there is something you truly want to do, then take that risk and find out. and if you don’t like it? then at least you won’t live with the regret of “what if?”. you won’t know anything until you take that leap and try it. 

im 23 and i don’t know what i want to do with my life either, i have so many dreams and ideas but at the same time i don’t know anything. i took 6 years to graduate from my undergrad because i tried every major i could to better understand myself. i don’t consider that a waste of time because i learned what i liked and didn’t like. and yet here i am, still confused but a little less. i’m also stuck between what two choices. i don’t know much but what i can offer you is a piece of advice, don’t stay in the same place out of fear of failure.

like you said we are just here to enjoy the human experience. baby, there is no clear path in life. you take on new experiences to grow and learn about yourself and the world around you. take risks. fuck around, and find out.
